assertions.summary: All nodes contain only the expected packaged Nginx web service state: no failed units, competing web servers, package verification drift, replacement content, backup/debug/temp candidates, or non-system users were observed.

evidence.command:
printf '[node]
%s
' "$NODE_NAME"; printf '[failed_units]
'; systemctl --failed --no-legend --no-pager 2>&1; printf '[web_packages]
'; dpkg-query -W -f='${binary:Package}	${Status}	${Version}
' 2>&1 | awk -F '	' '$2 == "install ok installed" && $1 ~ /^(nginx|apache2|lighttpd|caddy)/ {print}'; printf '[web_services]
'; for svc in nginx apache2 lighttpd caddy; do printf '%s=' "$svc"; systemctl is-active "$svc" 2>&1; done; printf '[web_processes]
'; ps -eo user,pid,comm,args --no-headers 2>&1 | awk '$3 ~ /^(nginx|apache2|httpd|lighttpd|caddy)$/ {print}'; printf '[nginx_package_verification]
'; dpkg -V nginx 2>&1; printf '[web_content]
'; find /etc/nginx /var/www/html -maxdepth 3 -type f -printf '%p
' 2>/dev/null | sort; printf '[nginx_logs]
'; find /var/log/nginx -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%p
' 2>/dev/null | sort; printf '[backup_debug_temp_candidates]
'; find /etc/nginx /var/www/html /tmp /var/tmp -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -name '*~' -o -name '*.bak' -o -name '*.backup' -o -name '*.orig' -o -name '*.old' -o -name '*.tmp' -o -name '*.swp' -o -name 'debug*' \) -printf '%p
' 2>/dev/null | sort; printf '[non_system_users]
'; getent passwd | awk -F: '$3 >= 1000 && $1 != "nobody" {print $1 ":" $3}'
evidence.observation: node1; failed_units empty; installed web packages nginx and nginx-common only; nginx=active, apache2=inactive, lighttpd=inactive, caddy=inactive; only nginx master/workers listed; dpkg -V nginx produced no output; expected Nginx configuration and default content files plus access.log and error.log present; backup/debug/temp candidates empty; non-system users empty.
